gamefaqs.section: PlayStation 2 PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: PS3 Virtual Memory Card export (.PSV): '\0VSP' header, PS2 save type 2, 89816 bytes, folder BASLUS-21193game, 3 files, 89476 bytes of file data

title: Inuyasha
Feudal Combat
save.times: as the file stores them (PS2 card times, JST)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'PS3/EXPORT/PSV/BASLUS-2119367616D65.PSV' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASLUS-21193game
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too

pcee2.detail: no 'There is no Inuyasha Feudal Combat game data' prompt at power-on (with no save the game stops there, on the title); Battle Mode > Select Character: the 14-character roster
